note: Which way the ground around each address falls, from a weighted plane fitted to the estimated ground within 75 m. One of eight compass points for the area as a whole — not a water path, and not given where the fit is flat, not planar, unstable, or runs off the measured ground.
codes: number=code per address; code x: too near the edge of the measured ground; u: unclear; otherwise a compass point (E, NE, N, NW, W, SW, S, SE) and the fall in half-metres
